body:
**Solution**

I suggest to remove the extra threadpool similar to rollup. The threadpool is unnecessary in its current design, because it is only used for startup. The startup phase is reasonable cheap and transform as a whole requires very few resources for orchestration. The main load happens in search and indexing, which runs separately. I consider the threadpool overdeveloped. Rollup came to the same conclusion and removed it in #65958.

In the long run we plan to develop better scheduling for transform, this will also act as load balancer and provide a better solution regarding resource utilization.

After discussing the issue - taking into account the likelihood of this problem to occur and the fact that the problem exists for quite some time - we think this issue is of low severity. A fix will be provided for the next minor release. At the moment we don't plan a backport to e.g. `7.x`. This decision might get re-accessed, if we get more reports/information.
The issue can only happen for rolling upgrade if a new index version is required and the threads block due to waiting for shards being active.
